# EST Co., Ltd.

> Distributor and export partner for ten leading Japanese building materials manufacturers.
> Ships worldwide direct from Japan. Based in Adachi-ku, Tokyo.

EST Co., Ltd. supplies overseas developers, importers, distributors, contractors and
hospitality groups with building materials sourced directly from Japanese manufacturers
that do not normally handle export themselves.

## Manufacturers represented
LIXIL (windows, entrance doors, kitchen, bath, tile, faucets) · Panasonic Housing
(kitchen, bath, lighting, interior, flooring) · DAIKEN (engineered flooring, ceiling,
soundproofing board) · NODA (interior doors) · Sangetsu (vinyl wallcovering, flooring) ·
Lilycolor (design wallcovering) · Nissin-EX (flooring, insulation coating) ·
Sincol (wallcovering, decorative film) · Toli (vinyl flooring, carpet tile) ·
Chiyoda Ute (gypsum board, fire-rated and moisture-resistant panels).

## Supply terms
FCL and LCL container consolidation across multiple brands in a single shipment.
Export desks at Yokohama, Nagoya and Osaka. FOB, CIF and DDP quoted on request.
Documentation is confirmed per line item and may include a commercial invoice, packing list,
Japanese Certificate of Origin, applicable JIS or fire documentation, F-four-star formaldehyde
grade and MSDS where applicable.

## Specification notes overseas buyers ask about
Japanese vinyl wallcovering is 92cm wide in 50m rolls, against the European 53cm in 10m.
F-four-star is the highest Japanese formaldehyde emission grade. Equivalence and acceptance
against overseas codes must be confirmed for the exact product and destination. Japanese fire
classes include Funen, Junfunen and Nannen; original test documentation is supplied where
available. Panel goods and unit bathrooms use product-specific Japanese dimensions and modules.
